question.text: N equally spaced charges each of value q , are placed on a circle of radius R . The circle rotates about its axis with an angular velocity $\omega$ as shown in the figure. A bigger Amperian loop B encloses the whole circle where as a smaller Amperian loop A encloses a small segment. The difference between enclosed currents, $I_A-I_B$, for the given Amperian loops is

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & I_A=\frac{N q}{\frac{2 \pi}{\omega}} \\ & I_A=\frac{N q \omega}{2 \pi}, I_B=0 \\ & I_A=I_B=\frac{N q \omega}{2 \pi}\end{aligned}$
